invariants.statement: A digital output (DO/DQ) is a PLC/RTU/controller output point or channel. Its existence does not by itself imply an external interposing relay.
invariants.consequence: Do not derive relay count from DO count.

invariants.statement: An external interposing/interface relay is a separate device used only when the documented interface requires functions such as isolation, voltage/current adaptation, contact multiplication or another explicit interface purpose.
invariants.consequence: Map relay purpose and wiring independently from the I/O point count.

invariants.statement: A PLC digital-output module can use different switching technologies, including transistor and relay outputs; output technology is a module characteristic and is distinct from an external interposing relay.
invariants.consequence: Do not use the word relay without distinguishing relay-output module from external interface relay.

invariants.statement: Quantity, naming similarity, tag prefix, adjacency in a list or generic industry practice is insufficient to prove a project-specific electrical/functional association.
invariants.consequence: Require project wiring, interconnection, I/O mapping, terminal plan, loop/panel schematic, cable schedule or explicit specification.

curated_sources.title: Lessons In Industrial Instrumentation
curated_sources.author: Tony R. Kuphaldt
curated_sources.supported_concept: Interposing relays are optional interface devices used between mismatched devices/circuits; PLC discrete I/O is a separate concept.

curated_sources.title: Interposing Relays in PLCs
curated_sources.supported_concept: An interposing relay may be driven by a PLC output when load/interface requirements justify it; it is not implied by every output.

curated_sources.title: S7-1200 Programmable Controller System Manual
curated_sources.supported_concept: Digital output modules exist with relay and non-relay output technologies; the output point is a controller I/O function.

curated_sources.title: ControlLogix Digital I/O Modules User Manual
curated_sources.supported_concept: Digital outputs are configured and controlled as individual module points independently of any external relay unless the field wiring uses one.

curated_sources.title: OpenPLC Runtime
curated_sources.supported_concept: Open-source PLC runtime implementation distinguishes I/O locations/outputs as controller data points; field interface hardware is platform-specific.

curated_sources.title: OpenPLC examples with CONTROLLINO
curated_sources.supported_concept: IEC-style digital-output addressing maps software outputs to physical hardware; hardware may expose separate digital and relay outputs.
